title: Hyve Smart Package Locker Review: Protecting Your Holiday Deliveries
summary: Hyve’s smart porch lockbox can secure incoming gifts—if your delivery driver uses it and there’s still room inside.
llm_summary: Hyve’s Smart Package Locker is a Wi‑enabled porch lockbox that lets you secure incoming deliveries, especially holiday gifts, by requiring a one‑time passcode or driver‑approved QR code to open. It works best when the delivery driver actually uses the locker and there’s enough space inside for the parcel, otherwise the package may still be left exposed.
